findings.desc: quality-cleanup: recover-evidence.ts:164-186 validateOk defaults to true when validateOutput is not a string (line 170 `if (typeof validateOutput === "string")` has no else branch). If the validate handler ever returns a non-string (e.g., after a future refactor from JSON.stringify to returning an object), the function silently reports status=pass despite no result being parsed. The comment at line 183 covers only the JSON.parse inner-try path, not the outer non-string path. An explicit else-branch setting validateOk=false (or logging a warning) would make the failure mode visible rather than silently passing.
